original.description: Warmth radiates from the crackling fire of the thick clay oven, and with it comes the smell of hot starapple jam and toasted matz.

source_shape: Narrow chimney offset right above broad domed/flared clay cap, arched open mouth with low central detail-colored fire mass, raised rectangular hearth/plinth with open horizontal base gap and inset lower foot.

palette.detail: R (d74200 in pinned palette) on actual source fire region only
palette.rule: Neutral clay and flame material plus independent fire mask; no fixed terracotta/glow/stone colors baked into production.

native_state: One fixed Items/sw_oven.bmp. Joppa preset AppleMatz/message remain native, not new food props. No child TileAnimationFrames or body Render changes in inspected Campfire; ExtinguishBlueprint defaults null and is unset in Oven/Joppa chain, so do not invent extinguish/unlit replacement or fire-frame loop. Native temperature/fire/status behavior stays native.

findings: Campfire derives IActivePart and handles cooking actions, preset meals and heat. No Tile/ColorString/DetailColor or Render override found in this class.
ExtinguishBlueprint is unset by default; extinguish action/replacement/frozen triggers are gated on a nonempty value. Oven/Joppa does not set it.
CampfireHeatSelfOnly is checked before radiating heat to cells/other objects. Source Oven provides that tag; no new heat/light/particle system implemented.
native_code_study.scope: Static installed code/definition study, not live native replacement validation.

native_behavior: Native preset AppleMatz, cooking interactions/meal message, ThermalInsulation700/CampfireHeatSelfOnly, solid non-takeable1000weight inorganic clay oven, FlameTemperature10000, HP1200, RenderLayer6 non-occluding; inherited MissileCover explicitly removed. Native quest/no-clear/hanging/heat state remains intact.

reference.equivalence: Partial clay/dome material reference. Qud silhouette/chimney position/base and fire role remain authoritative.

construction.camera: One fixed cardinal map-face, consistent shallow dome volume; no yaw/converging brick slab/3quarter oven.
construction.source_supported: Offset right chimney, flared dome/cap, arched opening with fire mass, broad raised plinth and base opening/inset support. Source w/R roles.
construction.authored: Smooth clay dome/arch curvature, modest chimney rim, plaster-like surface wear and shallow hearth bevel replace glyph stairs. Exact depth/wall thickness are authored; no food, logs, cookware, external smoke or new fire state added.
construction.openings: Arch around flame and low plinth slot remain true transparent geometry, not opaque black/background-colored paint. Fire stays within source mouth region.

frame.rule: One complete source cell and common clay/fire frame/pivot. No part bounds fitting or native rotation changes.

native_acceptance: Pending full-set generation: native preset/cooking/thermal/status/physics/visibility/no-clear behavior and save/load. No native activation or new animation.
